entries.name: Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) 2.0.2
entries.versionBasis: omg.org/spec/BPMN/ shows Version 2.0.2 as the only formal version, publication date January 2014.

licence.text: OMG spec licence: free licence to use the spec to create and distribute conforming software; copies must keep the notices, be informational, not be posted or resold, and not be modified
licence.basis: Read the 'USE OF SPECIFICATION - TERMS, CONDITIONS & NOTICES / LICENSES' front matter in the BPMN 2.0.2 PDF from omg.org.

norn.overlap: process models, tasks, gateways, events, lanes, message flows

entries.notes: The XSDs (CMOF/XSD, namespace 20100524/MODEL) are free to download but have no licence header, and the licence does not explicitly allow modifying or redistributing them. The OMG About-page JSON-LD carries dcterms:license MITLicense, but that appears to cover the page metadata, so we did not rely on it.

entries.name: Case Management Model and Notation (CMMN) 1.1
entries.versionBasis: omg.org/spec/CMMN/ shows Version 1.1 as the only formal version, publication date December 2016.

licence.text: OMG spec licence (implementation allowed; spec copies unmodified, non-commercial, with notices)
licence.basis: Read the 'USE OF SPECIFICATION - TERMS, CONDITIONS & NOTICES / LICENSES' front matter in the CMMN 1.1 PDF from omg.org.

norn.overlap: case files, stages, milestones, sentries, discretionary tasks

priority.reason: Process and decision models are how SAP-class suites configure behaviour.

entries.name: Decision Model and Notation (DMN) incl. FEEL
entries.versionBasis: omg.org/spec/DMN/1.6/ shows a formal specification with publication date September 2026 (JSON-LD 2026-09-25); DMN 1.5 formal is dated August 2024, and 1.7 is in beta (September 2026).

licence.text: OMG spec licence (implementation allowed; spec copies unmodified, non-commercial, with notices); IPR mode RF-Limited
licence.basis: Read the LICENSES front matter of the DMN 1.6 PDF from omg.org and the IPR mode 'RF-Limited' on the DMN 1.6 spec page.

norn.overlap: decision tables, business rules, FEEL expressions, decision requirement graphs

priority.reason: Decision tables use the DMN hit-policy profile.

entries.notes: The id keeps the suggested 'dmn-1-5', but the current formal version is 1.6, so renaming to dmn-1-6 is worth considering. FEEL is defined in the spec text, with no separate grammar artifact. The XSDs carry no licence header.
